paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Metzia 86b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.86b.2), where he spoke in the name of Rav.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage has Guryon ben Astyon giving an interpretation of Solomon’s provisions in Rav’s name. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=847&lang=en) cites that transmission.
